content: Different variations of the proposed classifier were evaluated. A single NB classifier (NB), a stack of two NB classifiers (NB+NB), a stack of a NB classifier and lexicon (NB+Lex) and a lexicon (Lex) by itself. A lexicon with a 50% training token dropout is also listed to show the impact of the lexicon support on the accuracy.
